Regulation 76 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – The Company has filed the reply/clarification to BSE and subsequently submitted the Reconciliation of Share Capital Audit Report. The Company has also taken necessary steps to ensure timely compliance with the applicable filing requirements in future.

Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – The Company had delayed the submission of the Audited Financial Results for the quarter and financial year ended 31st March, 2025. The delay was occasioned by the extended time required for completion of the statutory audit, reconciliation of financial records and finalization of the financial statements to ensure accuracy and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements. The delay was also noted in relation to non-disclosure of reasons for the delay in submission of financial results.

Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – The Company had received a mail from BSE dated 11th October, 2024 regarding non-submission of Declaration or Statement of Impact of Audit Qualifications for the year ended March, 2025 under Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
